A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is no evidence to support the use of WBRT as the sole treatment of surgically resectable single brain metastases in patients with newly diagnosed brain metastasis.
there is insufficient evidence to support the use of WBRT alone as the sole treatment of patients with newly-diagnosis, surgically accessible single brain metastases.
